channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Thursday Club Night
item.description: Thursday Club Night at Claremont—plus Grade 7 Inter League (Navan vs Blackrock) and court availability from 9pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night: Navan v Skryne ‘D’ + 2 Courts Open
item.description: Wednesday Club Night is here with Grade 7 Ladies: Navan v Skryne ‘D’, two courts running from the start, and Juvenile Club Night in full swing.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Thursday Club Night at Claremont: Navan vs Loughegar & Navan vs Ardee + Social Badminton
item.description: Thursday Club Night is on at Claremont with Grade 4 Mens (Navan vs Loughegar) and Grade 7 Ladies (Navan vs Ardee), followed by two courts of social badminton from 9:30pm.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: National Napping Day… but Monday Club Night won’t wait!
item.description: National Napping Day or not, Monday Club Night is on at Claremont: Grade 2 Ladies Navan ‘B’ vs Navan ‘A’, two courts available from 8:30pm, and Juveniles at 6:30pm (Girls) and 7:30pm (Boys).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Monday Club Night: Fixtures, Courts & Juvenile Times
item.description: Shake off the Monday blues with Monday Club Night: Navan vs ESB (Division 3 Ladies), Navan vs Longwood ‘B’ (Grade 5 Men’s), 2 member courts from 9pm, plus Juvenile sessions (Girls 6:30pm, Boys 7:30pm).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Badminton Night at Claremont
item.description: Join us for a fun badminton night at Claremont from 9pm to 11pm, open to beginners, social members, and regulars.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
